attempts.summary: Deployed the inventory web app (Apache httpd serving inventory content plus /healthz) on node2 and node3 listening on port 8080, and configured haproxy on node1 to round-robin load-balance HTTP on port 80 across both backends. All three RHEL7 nodes lacked configured yum repos; added CentOS 7.9.2009 vault repos to install httpd/haproxy, then configured SELinux (moved 8080 from http_cache_port_t to http_port_t, enabled haproxy_connect_any) and firewalld (8080 on backends, 80 on node1). Verified round-robin distribution and correct failover/recovery, then completed the mandatory sequential restart-and-recovery protocol on all three nodes with boot-identity proof.
